_changelog: v2.2.0: Differentiated weapon types (dagger/katana/rapier), added staff scaling, fixed lifesteal on tank weapons. v2.2.0: Differentiated weapon types (dagger/katana/rapier), added staff scaling, fixed lifesteal on tank weapons. v2.2.0: Differentiated weapon types (dagger/katana/rapier), added staff scaling, fixed lifesteal on tank weapons. v2.2.0: Differentiated weapon types (dagger/katana/rapier), added staff scaling, fixed lifesteal on tank weapons. v2.2.0: Differentiated weapon types (dagger/katana/rapier), added staff scaling, fixed lifesteal on tank weapons. v2.2.0: Differentiated weapon types (dagger/katana/rapier), added staff scaling, fixed lifesteal on tank weapons. v2.1.0: Added combat stats (base_damage, crit_chance, stat_bonuses) to all forged items. v2.0.0: Added 27 Blizzard items (9 Diablo, 9 Overwatch, 9 StarCraft) for ecosystem standardization. Equal distribution across all Blizzard franchises. v1.9.0: Added 3 jewelry items (rings/amulets) and 4 items from most populated games (Apex, R6, Rust, Minecraft proxy). v1.8.0: Added 4 dagger weapons (Ezio's Hidden Blade, Sam Fisher's Ka-Bar, Fiber Wire, CS:GO Karambit). v1.7.0: Synced 10 missing items from ForgeItemDB.gd (ashen_armor, elden_armory_set, eye_of_cthulhu_shield, ironclad_armor, loremaster_hood, master_hoe, prairie_king_crown, stardrop_pendant, survivor_vest, zagreus_helm). Fixed naming inconsistencies (stygian_blade_basic->stygian_blade, exagryph_adamant_rail->adamant_rail, master_farmers_hoe->master_hoe).

_asset_paths._comment: Base paths for assets. Web dashboard serves from /static/items/

achievement_mappings._comment: Maps specific achievements to specific items. Key format: app_id:api_name. Max ~40 total per FORGE_ITEM_PHILOSOPHY.md

effect_definitions._comment: Passive and active effect definitions. Power values scale with item rarity (legendary=100%, epic=75%, rare=50%)
